editorial.name: Adoric
editorial.descriptionZh: 给 Shopify 商家加客单价的几个 app：商品页捆绑、购物车加购、结账后加售、离站前弹窗，官网把每块单独做成一个产品段并标出各自的 AOV 涨幅。
editorial.takeawayZh: 看它怎么把加购瞬间做成一张订单卡
editorial.noteZh: 首屏近黑底带点阵纹理，导航是 Why Adoric / Apps / Affiliate / Blog 加右侧一颗白色 Explore apps 药丸，主标题 Clients come to buy. / Help them buy more.（buy more 是蓝色），下面 Explore apps 与 Book a demo 两颗按钮。右侧浮着两张卡：一张 ORDER TOTAL $50.00 配绿色 Save 0%，一张白色购物车卡带深绿 Buy now 按钮，右下角弹出 +1 item added 的小气泡。往下是一条数字带 24/7 Support、AI Powered offers、8,700 Active shops、705M Added revenue、5.0 Star ranking，再往后按 Bundle / Cart / Upsell 拆成三段，标题分别写 Client come for 1 product. Help to buy 2+ products、Upload any cart. Get yours back, smarter.、Clients already bought. Help them buy again.，各配 +23%、+21%、+8% 的 AOV 提升数字；Bundle 那段还列了 Quantity breaks、Mix and match、Dynamic bundle AI、Add-ons、Buy X get Y、Frequently bought together、Volume discounts、Free gift threshold 八种活动类型。
editorial.pricing: unknown - 首页只给 Explore apps 与 Book a demo，档位在 /classic/pricing

reasons.statement: 首页交付的是 Adoric 这套 Shopify app 的卖点分区与加购演示，没有可下载的组件或模板，用户拿走的是电商落地页的写法。
站内路径是 /demo、/live-demo、/classic/features、/classic/pricing 这类自家产品页，形态是产品官网。
